Now I have a good understanding of the AOT compatibility issues. The main problems are:

1. **`GenericOperationSource.cs`** - Uses `ModelReaderWriter.Read(response.Content, typeof(T))` (non-generic, reflection-based) and `Activator.CreateInstance` with reflection.

2. **`ArmOperation.cs`** - The `IsResource<T>()` method uses `typeof(T).GetConstructor(...)` and `Activator.CreateInstance(typeof(T), ...)` which are reflection-based.

6. **`GenericOperationSource.cs`** — Added `[UnconditionalSuppressMessage]` for IL2026/IL3050 on the reflection-heavy `CreateResult` method (only called from annotated public methods).
